d:
Build strength, raise your heart rate, and feel more capable in just 8 minutes. With squats, push ups, rock n roll planks, and a challenging extended plank hold, this quick full body workout delivers more than its length suggests.
Perfect when you’re short on time but still want a workout that leaves you feeling stronger, more organized, and ready for the rest of your day. Consistent effort, even in small doses, builds resilience that carries far beyond the mat.
